svg.text: 133 nodes · 62 relationships · 130 implied labels, generated from the CAEX 3.0 XML schema (GitHub AutomationML/AMLEngine2.1) and the AutomationML Edition 2.1 base and Part 2 role class libraries. The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the schema declaration or library download.
CAEX file: libraries, hierarchies and header information
CAEX objects: classes, instances, interfaces, links and attributes
AutomationML role classes, carried by InternalElements
AutomationML interface classes and attribute types
composition: element to the elements it contains
reference: a path or ID to the object it refers to
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: HAS_REVISION: Organizational information about the state of the revision. Each CAEXBasicObject has zero or more Revision. A composition: each Revision is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_SOURCE_OBJECT_INFORMATION: Organizational information about the source of the corresponding CAEX object. Each CAEXBasicObject has zero or more SourceObjectInformation. A composition: each SourceObjectInformation is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_SOURCE_DOCUMENT_INFORMATION: Provides information about the source(s) of the CAEX document. Each CAEXFile has one or more SourceDocumentInformation. A composition: each SourceDocumentInformation is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE: Container element for the alias definition of external CAEX files. Each CAEXFile has zero or more ExternalReference. A composition: each ExternalReference is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_REF_SEMANTIC: A reference to a definition of a defined attribute, e. g. to an attribute in a standardized library, this allows the semantic definition of the attribute. Each Attribute has zero or more RefSemantic. A composition: each RefSemantic is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_CONSTRAINT: Element to restrict the range of validity of a defined attribute. Each Attribute has zero or more Constraint. A composition: each Constraint is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Element that allows the description of nested attributes. Each Attribute has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

ATTRIBUTE_TYPE: References an attribute type in the attribute library. Resolves the RefAttributeType of the Attribute to the AttributeType it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each Attribute has at most one AttributeType.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Characterizes properties of the SystemUnitClass. Each InternalElement has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Characterizes properties of the InterfaceClass. Each ExternalInterface has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE: Each ExternalInterface has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

BASE_CLASS: Stores the reference of a class to its base class. References contain the full path to the referred class object. Resolves the RefBaseClassPath of the ExternalInterface to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its ID: the master object the mirror object repeats. Each ExternalInterface has at most one ExternalInterface.

BASE_CLASS: Stores the reference of a class to its base class. References contain the full path to the referred class object. Resolves the RefBaseClassPath of the ExternalInterface to the InterfaceClass it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each ExternalInterface has at most one InterfaceClass.

HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE: Description of an external interface. Each InternalElement has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_INTERNAL_ELEMENT: Shall be used in order to define nested objects inside of a SystemUnitClass or another InternalElement. Allows description of the internal structure of a CAEX object. Each InternalElement has zero or more InternalElement. A composition: each InternalElement is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

BASE_SYSTEM_UNIT: Stores the reference of an InternalElement to a class or instance definition. References contain the full path information. Resolves the RefBaseSystemUnitPath of the InternalElement to the InternalElement it identifies by its ID: the master object the mirror object repeats. Each InternalElement has at most one InternalElement.

HAS_ATTRIBUTE_NAME_MAPPING: Allows the definition of the mapping between attributes of a related role class or its interfaces and attributes of the hosting system unit. Each MappingObject has zero or more AttributeNameMapping. A composition: each AttributeNameMapping is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
SYSTEM_UNIT_INTERFACE: Resolves the SystemUnitInterfaceID of the InterfaceIDMapping to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its ID. Each InterfaceIDMapping has exactly one ExternalInterface.
ROLE_INTERFACE: Resolves the RoleInterfaceID of the InterfaceIDMapping to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its ID. Each InterfaceIDMapping has exactly one ExternalInterface.

HAS_INTERFACE_ID_MAPPING: Allows the definition of the mapping between interfaces of a related role class and interfaces of the hosting system unit. Each MappingObject has zero or more InterfaceIDMapping. A composition: each InterfaceIDMapping is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_MAPPING_OBJECT: Each SupportedRoleClass has at most one MappingObject. A composition: each MappingObject is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

ROLE_CLASS: Resolves the RefRoleClassPath of the SupportedRoleClass to the RoleClass it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each SupportedRoleClass has at most one RoleClass.

HAS_SUPPORTED_ROLE_CLASS: Allows the association to a RoleClass which this SystemUnitClass can play. A SystemUnitClass may reference multiple roles. Each InternalElement has zero or more SupportedRoleClass. A composition: each SupportedRoleClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

PARTNER_SIDE_A: Resolves the RefPartnerSideA of the InternalLink to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its owner's ID and its name, e.g. `788eb291-…:EnergySupply`. Each InternalLink has exactly one ExternalInterface.

PARTNER_SIDE_B: Resolves the RefPartnerSideB of the InternalLink to the ExternalInterface it identifies by its owner's ID and its name, e.g. `788eb291-…:EnergySupply`. Each InternalLink has exactly one ExternalInterface.

HAS_INTERNAL_LINK: Shall be used in order to define the relationships between internal interfaces of InternalElements. Each InternalElement has zero or more InternalLink. A composition: each InternalLink is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Characterizes properties of the RoleRequirements. Each RoleRequirements has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE: Each RoleRequirements has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_MAPPING_OBJECT: Host element for AttributeNameMapping and InterfaceIDMapping. Each RoleRequirements has at most one MappingObject. A composition: each MappingObject is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

BASE_ROLE_CLASS: Resolves the RefBaseRoleClassPath of the RoleRequirements to the RoleClass it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each RoleRequirements has at most one RoleClass.

HAS_ROLE_REQUIREMENTS: Describes role requirements of an InternalElement. It allows the definition of a reference to a RoleClass and the specification of role requirements like required attributes and required interfaces. Each InternalElement has zero or more RoleRequirements. A composition: each RoleRequirements is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

BASE_SYSTEM_UNIT: Stores the reference of an InternalElement to a class or instance definition. References contain the full path information. Resolves the RefBaseSystemUnitPath of the InternalElement to the SystemUnitClass it refers to by its path, which may start with an external file's alias and @. Each InternalElement has at most one SystemUnitClass.

HAS_INTERNAL_ELEMENT: Shall be used in order to define nested objects inside of a SystemUnitClass or another InternalElement. Allows description of the internal structure of a CAEX object. Each InstanceHierarchy has zero or more InternalElement. A composition: each InternalElement is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_INSTANCE_HIERARCHY: Root element for a system hierarchy of object instances. Each CAEXFile has zero or more InstanceHierarchy. A composition: each InstanceHierarchy is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Characterizes properties of the InterfaceClass. Each InterfaceClass has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE: Each InterfaceClass has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_INTERFACE_CLASS: Element that allows definition of child InterfaceClasses within the class hierarchy. The parent child relation between two InterfaceClasses has no semantic. Each InterfaceClass has zero or more InterfaceClass. A composition: each InterfaceClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

BASE_CLASS: Stores the reference of a class to its base class. References contain the full path to the referred class object. Resolves the RefBaseClassPath of the InterfaceClass to the InterfaceClass it identifies by its ID: the master object the mirror object repeats. Each InterfaceClass has at most one InterfaceClass.
HAS_INTERFACE_CLASS: Class definition for interfaces. Each InterfaceClassLib has zero or more InterfaceClass. A composition: each InterfaceClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_INTERFACE_CLASS_LIB: Container element for a hierarchy of InterfaceClass definitions. It shall contain any interface class definitions. CAEX supports multiple interface libraries. Each CAEXFile has zero or more InterfaceClassLib. A composition: each InterfaceClassLib is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Characterizes properties of the RoleClass. Each RoleClass has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE: Description of an external interface. Each RoleClass has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_ROLE_CLASS: Element that allows definition of child RoleClasses within the class hierarchy. The parent child relation between two RoleClasses has no semantic. Each RoleClass has zero or more RoleClass. A composition: each RoleClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

BASE_CLASS: Stores the reference of a class to its base class. References contain the full path to the referred class object. Resolves the RefBaseClassPath of the RoleClass to the RoleClass it identifies by its ID: the master object the mirror object repeats. Each RoleClass has at most one RoleClass.
HAS_ROLE_CLASS: Definition of a class of a role type. Each RoleClassLib has zero or more RoleClass. A composition: each RoleClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_ROLE_CLASS_LIB: Container element for a hierarchy of RoleClass definitions. It shall contain any RoleClass definitions. CAEX supports multiple role libraries. Each CAEXFile has zero or more RoleClassLib. A composition: each RoleClassLib is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Characterizes properties of the SystemUnitClass. Each SystemUnitClass has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE: Description of an external interface. Each SystemUnitClass has zero or more ExternalInterface. A composition: each ExternalInterface is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_INTERNAL_ELEMENT: Shall be used in order to define nested objects inside of a SystemUnitClass or another InternalElement. Allows description of the internal structure of a CAEX object. Each SystemUnitClass has zero or more InternalElement. A composition: each InternalElement is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_SUPPORTED_ROLE_CLASS: Allows the association to a RoleClass which this SystemUnitClass can play. A SystemUnitClass may reference multiple roles. Each SystemUnitClass has zero or more SupportedRoleClass. A composition: each SupportedRoleClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_INTERNAL_LINK: Shall be used in order to define the relationships between internal interfaces of InternalElements. Each SystemUnitClass has zero or more InternalLink. A composition: each InternalLink is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_SYSTEM_UNIT_CLASS: Element that allows definition of child SystemUnitClasses within the class hierarchy. The parent child relation between two SystemUnitClasses has no semantic. Each SystemUnitClass has zero or more SystemUnitClass. A composition: each SystemUnitClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

BASE_CLASS: Stores the reference of a class to its base class. References contain the full path to the referred class object. Resolves the RefBaseClassPath of the SystemUnitClass to the SystemUnitClass it identifies by its ID: the master object the mirror object repeats. Each SystemUnitClass has at most one SystemUnitClass.

HAS_SYSTEM_UNIT_CLASS: Shall be used for SystemUnitClass definition, provides definition of a class of a SystemUnitClass type. Each SystemUnitClassLib has zero or more SystemUnitClass. A composition: each SystemUnitClass is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_SYSTEM_UNIT_CLASS_LIB: Container element for a hierarchy of SystemUnitClass definitions. It shall contain any SystemunitClass definitions. CAEX supports multiple SystemUnitClass libraries. Each CAEXFile has zero or more SystemUnitClassLib. A composition: each SystemUnitClassLib is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_REF_SEMANTIC: A reference to a definition of a defined attribute, e. g. to an attribute in a standardized library, this allows the semantic definition of the attribute. Each AttributeType has zero or more RefSemantic. A composition: each RefSemantic is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_CONSTRAINT: Element to restrict the range of validity of a defined attribute. Each AttributeType has zero or more Constraint. A composition: each Constraint is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_ATTRIBUTE: Element that allows the description of nested attributes. Each AttributeType has zero or more Attribute. A composition: each Attribute is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE: Each AttributeType has zero or more AttributeType. A composition: each AttributeType is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

ATTRIBUTE_TYPE: References an attribute type in the attribute library. Resolves the RefAttributeType of the AttributeType to the AttributeType it identifies by its ID: the master object the mirror object repeats. Each AttributeType has at most one AttributeType.
HAS_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE: Class definition for attribute Types. Each AttributeTypeLib has zero or more AttributeType. A composition: each AttributeType is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_LIB: Container element for a hierarchy of Attribute type definitions. CAEX supports multiple attribute type libraries. Each CAEXFile has zero or more AttributeTypeLib. A composition: each AttributeTypeLib is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

g.title: CAEXBasicObject — CAEX basis object that comprises a basic set of attributes and header information which exist for all CAEX elements. Properties: id, changeMode, description, version, copyright, additionalInformation
Revision — Organizational information about the state of the revision. Properties: id, revisionDate, oldVersion, newVersion, authorName, comment
SourceObjectInformation — Organizational information about the source of the corresponding CAEX object. Properties: id, value, originId, sourceObjId
CAEXObject — CAEX basis object derived from CAEXBasicObject, augmented by Name (required) and ID (optional). Properties: id, name
CAEXFile — Root-element of the CAEX schema. Properties: id, schemaVersion, fileName, superiorStandardVersion

SourceDocumentInformation — Provides information about the source(s) of the CAEX document. Defines a structure to model information about the data source of the present CAEX document. Properties: id, originName, originId, originVendor, originVendorUrl, originVersion, originRelease, lastWritingDateTime, originProjectTitle, originProjectId
ExternalReference — Container element for the alias definition of external CAEX files. Properties: id, path, alias
InstanceHierarchy — Root element for a system hierarchy of object instances. Properties: id

InternalElement — Shall be used in order to define nested objects inside of a SystemUnitClass or another InternalElement. Allows description of the internal structure of a CAEX object. Defines base structures for a hierarchical object instance. The instance maybe part of the InstanceHierarchy or a SystemUnitClass. Properties: id, refBaseSystemUnitPath
Attribute — Characterizes properties of the SystemUnitClass. Defines base structures for attribute definitions. Properties: id, unit, attributeDataType, refAttributeType, defaultValue, value

RefSemantic — A reference to a definition of a defined attribute, e. g. to an attribute in a standardized library, this allows the semantic definition of the attribute. Properties: id, correspondingAttributePath

Constraint — Element to restrict the range of validity of a defined attribute. Defines base structures for definition of value requirements of an attribute. Properties: id, name, ordinalRequiredMaxValue, ordinalRequiredValue, ordinalRequiredMinValue, nominalRequiredValue, unknownRequirements
ExternalInterface — Description of an external interface. Shall be used for InterfaceClass definition, provides base structures for an interface class definition. Properties: id, refBaseClassPath
SupportedRoleClass — Allows the association to a RoleClass which this SystemUnitClass can play. A SystemUnitClass may reference multiple roles. Properties: id, refRoleClassPath
MappingObject — Base element for AttributeNameMapping and InterfaceIDMapping. Properties: id

AttributeNameMapping — Allows the definition of the mapping between attributes of a related role class or its interfaces and attributes of the hosting system unit. Properties: id, systemUnitAttributeName, roleAttributeName
InterfaceIDMapping — Allows the definition of the mapping between interfaces of a related role class and interfaces of the hosting system unit. Properties: id, systemUnitInterfaceId, roleInterfaceId
InternalLink — Shall be used in order to define the relationships between internal interfaces of InternalElements. Properties: id, refPartnerSideA, refPartnerSideB

RoleRequirements — Describes role requirements of an InternalElement. It allows the definition of a reference to a RoleClass and the specification of role requirements like required attributes and required interfaces. Properties: id, refBaseRoleClassPath
InterfaceClassLib — Container element for a hierarchy of InterfaceClass definitions. It shall contain any interface class definitions. CAEX supports multiple interface libraries. Properties: id

InterfaceClass — Class definition for interfaces. Defines base structures for a hierarchical InterfaceClass tree. The hierarchical structure of an interface library has organizational character only. Properties: id, refBaseClassPath
RoleClassLib — Container element for a hierarchy of RoleClass definitions. It shall contain any RoleClass definitions. CAEX supports multiple role libraries. Properties: id

RoleClass — Definition of a class of a role type. Defines base structures for a hierarchical RoleClass tree. The hierarchical structure of a role library has organizational character only. Properties: id, refBaseClassPath

SystemUnitClassLib — Container element for a hierarchy of SystemUnitClass definitions. It shall contain any SystemunitClass definitions. CAEX supports multiple SystemUnitClass libraries. Properties: id

SystemUnitClass — Shall be used for SystemUnitClass definition, provides definition of a class of a SystemUnitClass type. Defines base structures for a hierarchical SystemUnitClass tree. The hierarchical structure of a SystemUnit library has organizational character only. Properties: id, refBaseClassPath
AttributeTypeLib — Container element for a hierarchy of Attribute type definitions. CAEX supports multiple attribute type libraries. Properties: id
AttributeType — Class definition for attribute Types. Defines base structures for attribute type definitions. Properties: id, unit, attributeDataType, refAttributeType, defaultValue, value

AutomationMLBaseInterface — The AutomationML interface class AutomationMLBaseInterface, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

Order — The AutomationML interface class Order, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/Order. It is an AutomationMLBaseInterface. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. The interface class defines the attributes Direction. Properties: id

Port — The AutomationML interface class Port, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/Port. It is an AutomationMLBaseInterface. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. The interface class defines the attributes Direction, Cardinality and Category. Properties: id

PPRConnector — The AutomationML interface class PPRConnector, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/PPRConnector. It is an AutomationMLBaseInterface. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

ExternalDataConnector — The AutomationML interface class ExternalDataConnector, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/ExternalDataConnector. It is an AutomationMLBaseInterface. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. The interface class defines the attributes refURI. Properties: id

COLLADAInterface — The AutomationML interface class COLLADAInterface, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/ExternalDataConnector/COLLADAInterface. It is an ExternalDataConnector. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

PLCopenXMLInterface — The AutomationML interface class PLCopenXMLInterface, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/ExternalDataConnector/PLCopenXMLInterface. It is an ExternalDataConnector. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

ExternalDataReference — The AutomationML interface class ExternalDataReference, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/ExternalDataConnector/ExternalDataReference. It is an ExternalDataConnector. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. The interface class defines the attributes MIMEType. Properties: id

CommunicationInterface — The AutomationML interface class Communication, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/Communication. It is an AutomationMLBaseInterface. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

SignalInterface — The AutomationML interface class SignalInterface, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/Communication/SignalInterface. It is a CommunicationInterface. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

AutomationMLBaseRole — The AutomationML role class AutomationMLBaseRole, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

Group — The AutomationML role class Group, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Group. It is an AutomationMLBaseRole. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. The role class defines the attributes AssociatedFacet. Properties: id

Facet — The AutomationML role class Facet, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Facet. It is an AutomationMLBaseRole. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

Resource — The AutomationML role class Resource, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Resource. It is an AutomationMLBaseRole. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

Product — The AutomationML role class Product, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Product. It is an AutomationMLBaseRole. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

Process — The AutomationML role class Process, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Process. It is an AutomationMLBaseRole. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

Structure — The AutomationML role class Structure, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Structure. It is an AutomationMLBaseRole. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id

ProductStructure — The AutomationML role class ProductStructure, from the AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib (Automation Markup Language base role class library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLBaseRoleClassLib/AutomationMLBaseRole/Structure/ProductStructure. It is a Structure. Carried by an InternalElement whose RoleRequirements refer to this role class, or to one derived from it. Properties: id
